status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% more than the week before, most of them in Juba, Rumbek and Akobo.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Juba, Rumbek og Akobo.

summary.en: City councils in Juba are now collecting over 600 tonnes of waste daily, mainly from Thongpiny, and will start road repairs and install speed bumps within a week. The government is preparing climate-justice submissions to the African Court and addressing food insecurity worsened by El Niño and prolonged dry spells. President Kiir has posthumously promoted General Joseph Lagu to full General, while the caretaker finance minister has pledged financial reforms as the UK reaffirms support. Machar said he took steps to prevent violence in Nasir and Ulang after fishing-net disputes sparked clashes, and a Kenyan preacher who urged followers to starve to death was sentenced to 200 years in prison. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Byrådene i Juba samler nå over 600 tonn avfall daglig, hovedsakelig fra Thongpiny, og vil starte veireparasjoner og sette opp fartsdumper innen en uke. Regjeringen forbereder klima-rettferdighetsinnleveringer til Den afrikanske domstolen og tar tak i matusikkerhet som er forverret av El Niño og langvarige tørkeperioder. President Kiir har posthumt forfremmet general Joseph Lagu til full general, mens den midlertidige finansministeren har lovet økonomiske reformer mens Storbritannia bekrefter sin støtte. Machar sa han tok skritt for å hindre vold i Nasir og Ulang etter at tvister om fiskegarn utløste sammenstøt, og en kenyansk predikant som oppfordret sine tilhengere til å sulte til døden ble dømt til 200 år i fengsel. To dødsfall knyttet til kamp ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: South Sudanese Civil War
background.extract: The South Sudanese Civil War was a multi-sided civil war in South Sudan fought from 2013 to 2018 between government and opposition forces. The civil war caused rampant human rights abuses, including forced displacement, ethnic massacres, and killings of journalists by various parties. Since the war's end, South Sudan has been governed by a coalition formed by leaders of the former warring factions, Salva Kiir and Riek Machar. The country continues to recover from the war while experiencing ongoing and systemic ethnic violence.
